allow.heading: Customer onboarding sequence
allow.reason: Template-detail name is served data: GET /api/templates/:id returns the catalog entry and the page renders tpl.name dynamically (same class as fixture-rendered names). The design's template was also ADDED to the shipped catalog (api handlers/templates.ts, id 'customer-onboarding', webhook trigger, CRM sync + success-team alert nodes) so it is a real, installable template — but the static gate only scans app/src + fixtures, so the runtime-served name cannot register there.
